detail.longDescription: Frontier labs ship a lot. This gives me a handle on things. Also nice view of what the labs are prioritising (if release/research output is any indication).. Made with GPT-6.2 Astra High. Initial prompt was a bit rambly, some refinement over time. It suggested 'scry' which I thought was a bad name so now its called Frontier Observatory, which is a tad less terrible. Prompt: You know what I'd like to build.. a visuliastion studio where I can monitor the pace of output across various groups/sub-groups etc from the two predominant frontier labs racing to AGI.. I think it would make for a fascinating experience. I want the aesthetics to be out-wordly artistic, we want this to be like a portal.. a crystal bowl of making sense of the past and predicting the future.. Also need a clever name. Single word. Minimal.
